No ref() entry existed; sauloy2004 created 2026-09-07 by the triage. Cited by ramis-sauloy2006 as its reference [28]. No citation site yet; one bean queued.

relevance.rationale: An algebraic (no discrete summation, no Newlander-Nirenberg) route to the RSZ local classification, whose Prop 4.1 gives in one line the fact the corpus currently argues from RSZ §4.4 / Thm 3.3.5: the sheaf underlying the Stokes sheaf is the vector bundle over E_q of End^{>0}(M0) = sum over mu_i > mu_j of Hom(P_j, P_i), so a single-slope (pure isoclinic) formal class has End^{>0} = 0 and a trivial Stokes sheaf. Read: §1.1 (aims; three classical steps recalled), §2.1 (devissage: flat bundles over E_q, F_A for A in GL_n(C)), Thm 2.1, Prop 2.3, Thm 2.5/2.6 (recalled from RSZ: F(M0) -> H^1(E_q, Lambda_I)), Lemma 2.7-Cor 2.10 (flatness and q-Gevrey decay), §3 Thm 3.7 (canonical resummation F_D(U,V) along a divisor direction D, unique under a divisor bound on the over-diagonal blocks), Cor 3.8-3.9, Prop 3.12, Prop 3.14, Cor 3.16 (the (F_{D,D'}(U)) are a Cech cocycle), Thm 3.18 (F(M0) = H^1(E_q, Lambda_I(M0)) bijectively, algebraic proof), §4 Prop 4.1-4.2 and Lemma 4.3-Prop 4.4 (q-Gevrey filtration; H^1 of a proper open subset of E_q is trivial). Corpus consumers: RSZIsoformalInterface.lean (rszIsoformalDim_one, 'a pure isoclinic module has no isoformal moduli'), the c1-infinity-has-no-stokes-multiplier audit §'Why, from RSZ' item 2 (the Stokes-sheaf argument), QGevreyOrder.lean (q-Gevrey order — this paper's §4 filtration is the sheaf-level version). Not load-bearing: every corpus conclusion it supports is already sourced to RSZ; this is a cleaner and earlier citation for one of them. 'Stokes sheaf' greps: 1 content hit (references.ts note), 2 audits, 1 bean (qou-wgnx) — all RSZ-framed, none cites this paper.

keyResults.statement: lambda_I(M0) is the sheaf of sections of the holomorphic vector bundle over E_q associated to End^{>0}(M0), the sum of Hom(P_j, P_i) over mu_i > mu_j; the q-Gevrey filtration is the one inherited from End^{>0}(M0).
keyResults.useForFolio: With one slope End^{>0}(M0) = 0: the algebraic one-line form of 'pure isoclinic => trivial Stokes sheaf' behind rszIsoformalDim_one and the c1-infinity audit §2.

keyResults.statement: Canonical resummation of the formal isomorphism along a divisor 'direction' D on E_q, and the bijection F(M0) = H^1(E_q, Lambda_I(M0)) proved by the Cech cocycle of the F_{D,D'}.
keyResults.useForFolio: The 'direction of summation is a divisor on E_q' formulation, the algebraic counterpart of the theta-torsor reading in bean qou-wgnx.
